method.entry: close of the first NYSE session after the disclosure date
method.exit: close of the latest completed session stored for the ticker up to prices_as_of (SPY's newest stored session), at most one stored session before it (a session with no official SPY close stored, such as a stale scan day, holds no close and is stepped over)
method.benchmark: SPY closes on the same two sessions
method.prices: daily closes, not adjusted for dividends; a window containing a split is left blank
method.rows: purchases only; sales and exchanges get no value
method.scanned: rows from filings read from scanned images are not measured
